axes.title: The 2026 overbuild, its payback and the surplus still vacant
Implied vacancy and the vacancy parameter

texts: Implied vacancy and the vacancy parameter
The 2026 overbuild, its payback and the surplus still vacant
Vacancy parameter (5.39%, the published 2023 census value)
note: Reference, median population path (engine.absorb_overbuild). a: the 2026 overbuild, building above the requirement (positive), and the payback paid by building less (negative, outlined, hanging from the top of the overbuild; tick = net); below, the surplus still vacant U and the absorption weight w. The overbuild is absorbed by 2035 along the logistic (w = 1); once absorbed, the remaining 2026 overbuild is paid back in the same year (net 0, the ticks on the zero line). b: the unabsorbed surplus raises implied vacancy temporarily, which returns to the vacancy parameter once it is absorbed. The speed of absorption is bracketed by sensitivity (never absorbed, absorbed by 2030, by 2045).
